bugs.title: Blank / missing friend clips
bugs.detail:
## Status (Aug 7 dig)
Lane 1 P0. Roughly **43%** of friend clips missing on Aug 7 under the stricter “timelapse clip present” definition used that day.

## Ownership
Lane 1 — highest priority upload / media path work.

(Aug 8 dig: PR #29 merged; rate improved under media-join metric — see that day’s detail.)

bugs.title: Battery regression during sessions
bugs.detail: Battery drain during long recording sessions. Owned by Lane 3.

bugs.title: Search shows avatar, but non-friend profile detail doesn’t
bugs.detail:
## Symptom
Search shows avatar; non-friend profile detail shows initials only.

## Cause (later confirmed Aug 8)
`DiscoverableProfileView` drops `avatarURL` when constructing `Friend`.

## Blocker
PR blocked on GitHub reconnect.
evidence: Avatar present in search, missing on discoverable profile detail
